fusions.name: Cavalry Pass
fusions.desc: A trampling blow that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Thunder Stampede
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Charging Lunge
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you leap 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hardpan Gait
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 15%.
